policyReason: Leashed pets are welcome anywhere outdoors, but not inside the buildings.
summary: Leashed pets are welcome anywhere outdoors, but not inside the buildings.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed anywhere outdoors, provided they are properly restrained.

dogRules.text: Only service animals inside the visitor center and Old Courthouse.
No swimming in the reflecting pools or digging in garden beds.
Pets can earn a B.A.R.K. Ranger keepsake at the visitor center.
